title: Gaps Between Piecewise-Linear and Linear Embedding Dimensions
statement: Can the minimum dimensions for piecewise-linear embeddability and linear embeddability of a simplicial complex differ by more than one?
background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Discrete Differential Geometry (2006), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2006/12, pp. 653--728](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2006/12)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-21)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** Brehm--Sarkaria examples show a one-dimension gap between PL and linear embeddability, but no result found establishes or rules out a gap larger than one.

**Sources checked.**

- [original OWR problem](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2006/12)
- [Brehm--Sarkaria](https://archive.mpim-bonn.mpg.de/id/eprint/1946/1/preprint_1992_52.pdf)
